questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay in the right lane to avoid a potential hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach the intersection. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. Stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A traffic signal is coming up ahead. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn around and go the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road is about to curve or become narrower. You may see these signs on sharp curves or before narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead. Watch carefully for people crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: You must let other vehicles and pedestrians cross in front of you before moving forward. Slow down or stop if necessary.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Do not make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: A pedestrian crossing is coming up. Be careful and watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This diamond-shaped yellow warning sign alerts you to a steep hill ahead. Be prepared to adjust your speed to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about hazards or special conditions ahead. They are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead with a road joining from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead winds with a series of turns or curves.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you to be careful when driving in wet conditions because the road surface becomes slippery and harder to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop and check for traffic coming from both directions before proceeding.
Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
Maintain a steady speed and check for traffic coming from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop if needed to let other vehicles, cyclists, or pedestrians pass. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: School zone or school crossing sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zone or school crossing sign.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign alerts drivers to a school zone. This sign warns of school crossings where children and other pedestrians may be present.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you of a steep hill ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road curves sharply in the direction the arrow points. In this case, the road curves to the left. Multiple chevron signs may mark a single curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings and prepare you for upcoming road conditions. This sign alerts you to watch for bicycles crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. This sign is posted several hundred feet before the tracks to tell you to slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that shows rules you must follow. Right turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and proceed with caution.
Come to a complete stop as quickly as possible.
Stop and proceed only when the intersection is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and be careful. You do not need to stop completely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that a sharp turn is coming. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is located to your right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped sign marks where passing other vehicles is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign alerts you that roadwork is coming up. Stay alert for temporary traffic signs in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Proceed at a consistent speed while looking and listening for approaching trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, slow down and look and listen for trains. Be ready to stop if you see or hear a train approaching. Never try to race a train.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign tells you that the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns you that traffic will merge in from the right side. Be prepared.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the marked line. If there is no line, stop before the crosswalk or before the intersection where you can see all directions. Only proceed when it is safe.
